definitions.explanation: an onomatopoeic expression representing open, hearty laughter; often used in text to express amusement

examples.japanese: あはは、{面白|おもしろ}い！
「あはは、{冗談|じょうだん}でしょ？」

notes:
LAUGHTER ONOMATOPOEIA:
Japanese has many words to express different types of laughter:

OPEN/HEARTY:
- あはは - ha ha ha (open laugh)
- わはは - hearty laugh (often masculine)
- がはは - loud, boisterous laugh

QUIET/RESTRAINED:
- うふふ - quiet, often feminine giggle
- くすくす - suppressed giggle
- ふふふ - soft chuckle

EMBARRASSED/NERVOUS:
- えへへ - sheepish laugh
- あはは (with awkwardness) - nervous laugh
- へへへ - slightly mischievous

NEGATIVE:
- にやにや - smirk
- げらげら - laughing loudly (can be rude)
